items.title: How much does skipping recovery seasons actually cost over 10 years?
items.description: Model a 10-year (40-quarter) career as repeating cycles of a 2-quarter push season (at 150% output) followed by a recovery season. Each push needs 2 quarters of recovery to fully pay off; unrecovered debt compounds and eventually forces a low-output burnout crash. Drag the slider to set how many recovery quarters actually get taken after each push — Priya's pre-inflection pattern (from L3) is close to 1.

params.name: recoveryQuartersTaken
params.label: Recovery quarters taken per push season

items.compute: const totalQuarters = 40; const sprintQuarters = 2; const sprintOutput = 1.5; const recoveryOutput = 0.5; const requiredRecovery = 2; const recoveryTaken = params.recoveryQuartersTaken; const cycleLength = sprintQuarters + recoveryTaken; const numCycles = Math.floor(totalQuarters / cycleLength); const debtPerCycle = Math.max(0, requiredRecovery - recoveryTaken); const totalDebt = debtPerCycle * numCycles; const crashQuarters = Math.min(totalQuarters, Math.round(totalDebt * 1.5)); const crashOutput = 0.15; const normalQuartersOutput = numCycles * (sprintQuarters * sprintOutput + recoveryTaken * recoveryOutput); const remainderQuarters = totalQuarters - numCycles * cycleLength; const remainderOutput = remainderQuarters * 1; let cumulativeOutput = normalQuartersOutput + remainderOutput; cumulativeOutput = cumulativeOutput - crashQuarters * (1.2 - crashOutput); cumulativeOutput = Math.round(Math.max(0, cumulativeOutput) * 10) / 10; return { cumulativeOutput };
